page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; page number at top left. Main text in one column. Marginal note in the left margin beside the line "Rem. R.". Below the text: a centred chapter heading "CAP. IV.", an italic title, and the opening paragraph. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: eft efficientia caufæ, quam effectus eft.
Ob.ς[?]. Si Deus determinet actus liberos, de-
terminat etiam potentias. Nam potentiæ sunt
caufæ actuum. At si potentiæ determinetur, nullo
modo manet potentia volendi & nolendi. Ita
Rem. R. Potentias voluntatis particulares
numero actibus futuris commensurari, & ad
laudem gloriosæ providentiæ determinari affe-
ro, ab eo qui numerat capillos capitis &
pluviarum guttulas: at manet potentia vo-
luntatis universalis indeterminata. 2. Non
satis accurate dicunt doctores hi, potentiam
esse caufam actuum. Causa est præstantior effe-
ctu, potentia actu ignobilior posita causa, poni-
tur effectus, posita vero potentia non ponitur
actus. Accurate itaque loquendo causa actu liberi
est potentia determinata, non simpliciter potentia.
Ob. 6. Si ponatur talis efficacia determi-
nans, tolletur studium & pia bene operandi
solicitudo. Exspectabimus enim semper effi-
caciam talem. R. Non potest non esse solicit-
us aliquis, quamdiu talem efficaciam in con-
versione non sentiat, ideoque contrarium po-
tius sequetur.
CAP. IV.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the page number "302" at top left; the marginal note line "379" (possibly "179") is not in the note text; the symbol after "Ob." in the first paragraph ("ς") is an ornamental mark and may be a printed number. The catchword "vunt" is the start of the next word of "refolvunt". The word "potentia" appears in the scan as "potetia" in places, and that spelling may be a printing error. The long s has been transcribed as s throughout.
